challenge.name: The Locked Shadow
challenge.description: A supplier contract for the next promotion week is already signed, and the team cannot deploy the new model without a shadow run to verify it. #reliability_ruth# demands a fully automated and governed shadow environment to protect the live forecast, while #automation_alex# insists on keeping it manual to avoid breaking the current pipeline stability.

output.content: The shadow run orchestration is currently done by hand, requiring manual configuration for every new model version. I am willing to accept this manual step for the immediate promotion week. The automated setup path requires a new tool that is not yet approved by the infrastructure committee. Until that approval lands, I would rather keep the pipeline stable with a human in the loop than risk breaking the live forecast integration. This manual handling is the price I am prepared to pay to avoid introducing an unvetted dependency into the critical path right now.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are willing to accept the burden of manual configuration to avoid the risk of introducing an unvetted dependency, indicating a conscious sacrifice of convenience for stability.
